# jochwacht-sbom 0.12.1 — one line of help still said the old name

`jochwacht-sbom --help` described `--send` as *"Send the bill of materials to
**jochwacht** for a free CRA readiness report"*. The rename missed it because
the guard that checks for the old name read `README.md` and nothing else —
and a customer meets the help text far more often than the README.

Nothing else changed. If you already have 0.12.0, the tool behaves
identically; only the wording is corrected.

The guard now reads the strings the CLI actually prints, and fails on the
exact line that shipped.
